tools.input:
SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation High Schools (Public)'
  AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

output.sql:
SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation High Schools (Public)'
  AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3
